_leverage_policy: The net-leverage limit is enforced to within whole-contract rounding, not exactly (HD 2026-09-20). Measured on the futures backtest 2024-05-03..2026-05-03 with the ARM 1 risk loop: worst excess 1.61 contracts (9.5 %) on a 17-contract book, 40 of 55 over-limit days within one contract (excess = gross contracts x (1/leverage_mult - 1) at the gate's last reading; a proxy, since contracts differ in notional). Hard constraints in the optimiser's integer search were measured and not taken (more churn than today); they are re-measured after the cost penalty is fed. A trading day whose final rounded book is over the limit logs one RISK_LEVERAGE_ROUNDED WARN with the day and the excess in contracts (never on a warm-up rebalance; T-7b-2 C9w).

modules._overlay_limits_note: the overlay reads the book in capital terms (weights on the sizing capital): R_max, R_jump_max and R_shock_max are ratios to the first sleeve's risk target tau; max_gross_leverage and max_net_leverage are L_max and L_net_max
modules._missing_symbol_policy_reason: Schema-1 behaviour, migrated literally: risk_manager.cpp:55-58 gates the book on the subset of its symbols present in the window (T-4 §10). Changing it is its own measured commit.
